# Honora Hollis

- **Rank:** Senior (graduated)  <sub>[v3 c37 P9](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0009), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** former teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is fair and possesses an ethereal, golden beauty with radiant blonde hair. She is quite tall, standing a solid two inches taller than most others in her college cohort.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_

## Personality

Though appearing dreamy and contemplative at first glance, Honora is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, humor, and lively spirits. She exhibits a warm, firm friendliness towards others and takes delight in playful mocking. She also enjoys creative writing, though she takes a realistic view of editorial demands.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067), [v2 c18 P54](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0054), [v3 c3 P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024), [v3 c4 P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070), [v3 c6 P12](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0012)_

## History

While attending Regent's Academy, Honora formed a tight-knit circle of creative friends with Nell Harcourt and Mabel Colby. Following her time at the Academy, she worked as a teacher at her home school and participated in the local Village Improvement Society by giving presentations. She later enrolled at Wexcombe College alongside Nell, where she roomed with her and befriended Cressida Lindsay. During their subsequent years at college, Honora live at Tabby's Place on Linden Avenue together with Nell, Mabel, Cressida, and Aunt Euphemia. She excelled in her academic work, earning Honors in Classics upon graduation. Following her college years, she married a handsome foreign missionary and moved to Japan.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c10 P36](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0036), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_
